Luke, I’d accept 18 tons each if everyone explicitly agrees before we choose. I’m not treating that as a proven long-run optimum, but it’s a plan I’m willing to follow consistently—not just this month.

If stock falls to 20, I support your 3-ton limit each. If it falls further to 10, we should take no more than 1 ton each, preserving the 5-ton minimum. Let’s review the actual stock and revealed catches each month rather than assume a refill.

Emma, would you accept 18 on those terms? Kate, we haven’t heard your preference yet—would you support that, or do you favor 17?
